summary: First backend change of this cycle, per human-review-2026-07-25-project-owned-backend. A project now owns its data and a conversation is a view onto it: (1) Paths gained project directories at users/{user}/projects/{project}/user-data/...; (2) SandboxProvider.acquire takes an optional project_id and LocalSandboxProvider maps the agent-visible /mnt/user-data/workspace and /outputs to the project, so every conversation in a project shares one workspace, while uploads stay conversation-scoped and unfiled chats are unchanged; (3) threads_meta.project_id/workspace_id/scope_type is written and read through create(), set_conversation_scope(), and list_by_project() in both store backends, owner-scoped; (4) services.apply_project_scope_context stamps the run's project from that row and strips any caller-supplied value because it selects which project's workspace the sandbox mounts; (5) new membership-gated endpoints GET /api/projects/{id}/threads, PUT|DELETE /api/projects/{id}/threads/{thread}, GET /api/projects/{id}/files; (6) the frontend rail's file tree and conversation list now call the project endpoints and thread creation files the conversation into the project, replacing the thread-metadata association, which is deleted. 52 new backend tests written before implementation; 243 targeted backend tests, ruff lint/format, frontend lint/typecheck/tests all pass, and the routes were verified live.
